info.name: Seren Blue Safaris API
info.description:
Full API collection for Seren Blue Safaris backend (Laravel + Sanctum).

## Setup
1. Import `SerenBlueSafaris.postman_environment.json` and select it.
2. Set `base_url` (e.g. http://localhost:8000/api).
3. Run **Auth → Login** — token, user_uuid, and other ids are auto-saved to the environment.
4. Subsequent protected requests read `{{token}}` automatically from collection-level Bearer auth.

All requests use `Accept: application/json`. Dynamic fields (uuids, ids) are captured from responses via test scripts where sensible.

exec: // Global pre-request: ensure base_url exists and normalise it
const ensure = (key, value) => { if (!pm.environment.get(key)) pm.environment.set(key, value); };
// generate a per-request idempotency key if needed
// Global test: auto-capture token & common ids from any response
const pickToken = (o) => o && (o.token || o.access_token || (o.user && (o.user.token || o.user.access_token)) || (o.data && (o.data.token || o.data.access_token)));
if (d.currencies && d.currencies[0]) { pm.environment.set('currency_id', d.currencies[0].id); if (d.currencies[0].uuid) pm.environment.set('currency_uuid', d.currencies[0].uuid); }
